project_description:

 Description 
 The SIBS API module is a powerful and versatile solution that seamlessly integrates secure payment options into your Drupal online platform. By implementing this advanced payment gateway, you can provide customers with a fast, reliable, and secure payment experience that enhances your website's functionality and boosts customer satisfaction.

 Back to top 

 About SIBS and JAVALI 
 SIBS is the leading provider of electronic payment processing in Portugal and one of Europe’s top payment providers. It is known for its cutting-edge security and high standards in payment processing. JAVALI has been selected as a Premium Partner by SIBS, recognizing its expertise and contributions to online payment integration, which are showcased in this Drupal module.

 
 

 Back to top 

 Key Advantages of Integrating the SIBS API in Drupal 
 
 Streamlined Payment Process : The SIBS API simplifies transactions, allowing customers to purchase quickly and conveniently within your Drupal site. With a user-friendly and secure checkout experience, customers complete payments without redirection, improving conversion rates and customer retention.

 
 

 
 Enhanced Payment Security : With advanced security protocols, the SIBS API protects sensitive data, ensuring safe transactions directly on your site. This high-security payment processing offers customers peace of mind, safeguarding their financial information and building trust. 
 Comprehensive Financial Visibility : Integrate the SIBS API for enhanced insight into your site’s financial flow, supporting strategic decision-making with clear, precise data. Internal analysis tools, including transaction and revenue graphs, provide deeper financial insights for administrators.

 
 

 
 
 Back to top 

 Supported Payment Methods with SIBS API 
 
 MB WAY : Enable payments through MB WAY, a popular choice in Portugal that allows instant, mobile-based transactions. Customers enjoy a quick and convenient payment experience directly from their smartphones. 
 Credit Card Payments (Cartão de Crédito) : Support direct credit card payments on your Drupal platform. Customers can securely enter their card details directly on your site, reducing friction and eliminating redirects to external pages. 
 ATM Reference Payments (Referência de Multibanco) : The SIBS API supports payments via ATM references, allowing customers to receive a unique reference number and complete their transactions at any ATM or through online banking. This flexible option is trendy in Portugal and provides added convenience for customers. 
 
 Back to top 

 Why Integrate SIBS API on Your Drupal Site? 
 Integrating the SIBS API is a strategic choice to boost sales and deliver a reliable, efficient payment solution tailored to your customers' needs. With SIBS’ robust security and flexible payment methods, you’ll enhance transaction security, streamline the payment process, and increase customer satisfaction on your Drupal platform. SIBS is trusted by over 300 million users across Europe, making it a reliable choice for businesses seeking secure and scalable payment integration.

 
Note: A contract with SIBS is required to activate this API for your website.
